title:
Epic to modify 'manuallyIncludedSensors' and 'manuallyExcludedSensors' in Reliability.DataPreparationApplicationState
when users interact with the '+' or '-' row actions, or the 'Include Sensors' or 'Exclude Sensors' multiple row actions on the
`Reliability.AssetDataPrepSelectedSensorGrid` and `Reliability.AssetDataPrepExcludedSensorGrid`.

This epic listens for actions triggered by user interactions with these buttons. It processes the action payload to
determine which sensors should be included or excluded, updates the application state accordingly, and triggers
additional actions to refresh the data grids.

The payload of the action is expected to contain the following fields:
- `obj`: The sensor data report object that needs to be updated in case of '+' or '-' row actions.
- `stateId`: The state ID of the application in which the fields need to be updated.
- `shouldExcludeSensor`: Indicates whether the sensor should be excluded.
  If `true`, the sensor will be added to the list of manually excluded sensors.
  If `false`, the sensor will be added to the list of manually included sensors.
- `includeGridId`: The grid ID that displays the included sensors `Reliability.AssetDataPrepSelectedSensorGrid`.
- `excludedGridId`: The grid ID that displays the excluded sensors `Reliability.AssetDataPrepExcludedSensorGrid`.
- `isBulkOperation`: Indicates whether the operation is a bulk operation.
  If `true`, the action will apply to multiple sensors at once.
  If `false`, the action will apply to a single sensor.
name: DataPreparationManuallyUpdateSensorEpic
